children: The 10-year French OAT yield pares some of its falls after flash estimate purchasing managers data. The French flash composite PMI index came in at 51.2 in September, well above analyst expectations of 48.6 in The Wall Street Journal's poll. The 10-year OAT yield last trades at 4.480%, down 0.8 basis points on the day, compared with 4.474% beforehand, according to Tradeweb data. The euro shows limited reaction, continuing to hover just above an earlier eight-week low of $1.1420 against a firmer dollar. (emese.bartha@wsj.com)
